operation.condition: One immutable trace, fixed window identity within a question, shared representation caches within the stream, and an authenticated upper bound on index purchase bytes.
operation.calculation: Start packed. Switch before the next new packed chunk would exceed the cheapest announced cap. Preserve certified windows and use the verified index for the unresolved ones.
operation.bound: At most twice the minimum of the packed stream cost and the announced index cap. The actual best partition may read a strict subset of its announced cap.

authority: Work starts with trusted preparation descriptors and window manifests loaded. Representation proof and payload bytes count. The two-times bound uses the smallest announced whole-index cost cap and the packed streaming cost. The cheapest actual fixed stream is reported separately.
